name: The Call of Ashenfall
description: Speak with Captain Aric, accept his warning, and prepare to leave Stonehold.
story: Aric does not promise glory. He asks whether you can look at the darkness without pretending it belongs to someone else.

name: Ashes on the Road
chapter: Chapter I  -  Ashes of the Past
description: Follow the Gloam Gate road into Gloamwood and find Warden Kael.
story: The gate captain tells you the patrol carried six lanterns. Only five lanterns were recovered. The sixth is still burning somewhere in the forest.
why: Aric is sending you because the missing patrol is the first sign that the old danger may be returning.
lore: The sixth lantern was not recovered. Someone chose to leave it burning.

name: The Lantern That Lied
chapter: Chapter I  -  Ashes of the Past
description: Speak with Warden Kael and learn what the violet ash means.
story: Kael tells you the ash is not drifting from the sky. It is climbing upward from cracks beneath the roots.
why: Kael needs proof that the ash is connected to the Veil scars before the Council can dismiss the disappearances.
lore: The ash rises from beneath the roots; the forest is sitting on a wound.

name: The Lost Patrol
chapter: Chapter I  -  Ashes of the Past
description: Defeat a Hollow Wolf and recover the broken patrol lantern.
story: The wolf's eyes are clouded by violet fire. Its collar bears a Lantern Guard insignia - and fresh blood.

name: Lanterns in the Forest
chapter: Chapter I  -  Ashes of the Past
description: Defeat 3 Gloomroot Spiders around the old lantern trail.
story: The spiders are not hunting you. They are guarding something beneath the roots.

name: The Old Lantern
chapter: Chapter I  -  A Witness in the Dark
description: Find Keeper Havel at the forgotten watch and hear what he remembers.
story: Havel remembers the missing patrol. He says one of the soldiers came back before the others vanished - and begged him never to ring the lantern bell.
why: Havel is the last living witness to the old watch. His memory may be the only map to the truth.
lore: The patrol heard a bell before it vanished, and one soldier came back begging Havel not to ring the lantern bell.

name: Whispers Between Trees
chapter: Chapter I  -  A Witness in the Dark
description: Recover 4 Gloomroot fibers from spiders near Havel's watch.
story: The fibers hum with the same note Havel heard beneath the lantern tower.

name: Below the Roots
description: Return to Captain Aric, gather a party if you wish, and descend into the Sunken Catacombs.
story: Kael's final instruction is simple: if the bell rings, do not answer it. The roots open like a wound.

name: The Hollow Saint
description: Defeat the Hollow Saint and learn what answers the bell beneath the Catacombs.
story: The Saint was once a guardian. As he dies, he whispers a name no living historian remembers: Eir-Vhal.
why: The Saint was once a guardian. Killing him may reveal what the guardians were protecting.
lore: Eir-Vhal is the first name that does not belong to any surviving kingdom.

name: The Black Road
chapter: Chapter III  -  A Door That Remembers
description: Return to Captain Aric in Stonehold, take the Black Road east, and reach the Black Citadel alive.
story: Aric finally admits what he feared: the Citadel was not abandoned after the fall. Something has been keeping the old road open. He gives you a sealed Lantern Guard order bearing Vey’s name.
why: Aric cannot spare a full company, so he sends one person who has already seen the ash and survived.
lore: The Black Citadel was built around a door, not merely defended by one.

name: The Citadel Below
chapter: Chapter III  -  A Door That Remembers
description: Enter the Dreadvault beneath the Black Citadel and reach the sealed lower vault.
story: Vey says the Citadel was built around a door. The deeper you go, the more the door remembers the people who came before you.

name: The Name Below
chapter: Chapter III  -  A Door That Remembers
description: Defeat the Vault Tyrant and bring proof of what lives beneath the Black Citadel back to Quartermaster Vey.
story: The Tyrant dies without roaring. It simply says your character's name, as if it has known you for years.
why: Vey needs proof because the Council will not believe a rumor, and the Citadel cannot be abandoned twice.
lore: The thing below knows the player’s name before the player has met it.

name: A Light for the Missing
description: Defeat 3 Hollow Wolves and recover enough lantern oil for the patrol families.
story: Mira keeps the names of every missing guard in a ledger. She refuses to let the city turn them into numbers.

name: Thread of the Gloam
description: Defeat 5 Gloomroot Spiders for Keeper Havel's warding thread.
story: Havel weaves the silk into a ward that makes the lantern burn without feeding the thing beneath the roots.

name: The First Vein
description: Mine 3 Copper Ore and bring the lesson back to Hesta Stonehand.

name: Ore for the Forge
description: Mine 3 Umbral Iron Ore for Brannik and learn how to temper it.

name: First Tempering
description: Forge a Wayfarer Blade for the training yard and let Brannik judge your first proper temper.

name: Market Day
description: Sell one item to a vendor and learn the rhythm of the Stonehold market.

name: List for the Market
description: List one item on the Auction House for another adventurer to find.

name: Lantern Oil
description: Defeat 4 Hollow Wolves near the Gloam Gate and recover their oily pelts.

name: The Gloam Hunters
description: Defeat 5 Gloam Huntmasters in the forest hunting grounds.

name: Ashes of the Cult
description: Defeat 6 Gloam Cultists and recover their Veil-marked ash.

name: A Vein of Stars
description: Mine 4 Star-Iron Ore from the deeper Gloamwood veins.

name: Cleanse the Gallery
description: Clear the first two trash rooms of the Sunken Catacombs.

name: Supplies for the Citadel
chapter: Chapter III  -  A Door That Remembers
description: Find Quartermaster Vey inside the Black Citadel and deliver Aric’s sealed order.
story: Vey breaks the seal, reads the order twice, and burns it. He tells you the Citadel did not fall in a single night. The soldiers inside simply stopped remembering which side of the door they were on.

name: Arms of the Black Road
chapter: Chapter III  -  A Door That Remembers
description: Defeat 3 Risen Guardians in the Ashen Wastes before entering the Citadel.

name: Hands Across the Market
description: Complete one player-to-player trade.

name: The Sixth Lantern
description: Return to Keeper Havel and ask why the missing patrol carried six lanterns when only five were ever recovered.
story: Havel finally tells the part he kept buried: the sixth lantern was never lost. It was carried beneath the roots by the patrol captain himself. Havel heard the flame answer the bell, as though the lantern had been waiting for it.

name: Names, Not Numbers
description: Speak with Mira in Stonehold and help her restore the names of the missing patrol to the Guard ledger.
story: Mira shows you the Guard ledger. Six names are written in ink; beside the sixth is a line that has been scraped away so violently that the parchment is nearly torn. She refuses to let the city forget them.

name: The Warden’s Warning
description: Return to Warden Kael after the Hollow Saint and ask what the name Eir-Vhal means.
story: Kael admits the name is older than Stonehold. Eir-Vhal was not a god, king, or demon in the surviving records. It was the name given to a place where the Veil was first stitched shut - and the stitches are failing again.

name: Echoes of Eir-Vhal
description: Defeat 4 Risen Guardians in the Ashen Wastes and listen for the bell beneath their armor.
story: The guardians do not speak when they fall. Their armor does. Each empty breastplate gives the same faint chime. Kael hears it from the city and realizes the bell beneath the world has started calling through the dead.

name: The Dead Watch
description: Defeat 3 Risen Guardians outside the Black Citadel and recover the insignia of Vey’s first watch.
story: Vey recognizes the insignia immediately. It belonged to the first squad he commanded. He has carried the memory of their last stand for years, but their armor is now walking again.

name: Ash and Blood
description: Defeat 5 Ashen Reavers on the road beneath the Citadel and bring Vey proof that the corruption is spreading outward.
story: Vey studies the ash on your blade and stops smiling. The Reavers are not coming from the Wastes. They are coming out of the Citadel. Whatever is below is no longer staying below.

name: The March of Crows
description: Speak with Sergeant Mara and learn why Lantern Guard scouts are abandoning the old patrol road.
story: Mara has seen crows flying south for three straight nights. The birds ignore food and refuse to cross one particular stretch of road. She says soldiers have started doing the same.

name: Ore Under Foot
description: Mine 3 Umbral Iron Ore along the abandoned patrol road and bring it to Sergeant Mara.
story: The ore is warm despite the cold ground. Mara says the patrol road was built over an older road, and the older road was built over something that should have remained buried.

name: Shadows at the Gate
description: Speak with Shade Master Vey and learn why the Lantern Guard keeps a Rogue at the gate after dusk.
story: Vey does not teach you to disappear for the sake of fear. He teaches you to choose the moment when fear belongs to your enemy.

name: A Clean Cut
description: Prove your discipline by defeating 5 Gloamwood predators without abandoning your target.
story: Vey watches the wounds you leave behind. A Rogue who wastes motion wastes opportunities.

name: Venom in the Veins
description: Bring a forged Gloamfang blade to Shade Master Vey.
story: Vey recognizes the blade by its balance, not its name. He tells you that the finest weapon is the one that makes the enemy choose the wrong response.

name: The Last Shadow
description: Defeat 1 Ashen Reaver in Gloamwood while keeping your pressure on the same target.
story: The Reaver does not flee when wounded. For the first time, Vey smiles. 'Good. Now you are learning when not to vanish.'

name: Guardian of the Lantern
chapter: Class Story  -  The Light Between Us
description: Speak with Hierophant Elira and accept her first field lesson.
story: Elira tells you that healing is not merely restoring flesh. It is deciding who must be standing when the next blow lands.

name: Hold the Line
chapter: Class Story  -  The Light Between Us
description: Restore the health of your party during a dangerous hunt and defeat 5 Gloamwood predators.
story: The lesson is simple: keep your companion alive long enough for them to do what you cannot.

name: The Lantern's Burden
chapter: Class Story  -  The Light Between Us
description: Bring a forged Lanternkeeper's Mace to Hierophant Elira.
story: Elira explains that a healer carries the party's mistakes as surely as its wounds. The goal is not perfection. It is making the next mistake survivable.

name: Mercy Under Ash
chapter: Class Story  -  The Light Between Us
description: Defeat 1 Hollowed Guardian and keep moving forward.
story: The guardian rises again after death. Elira does not flinch. 'Some things are not asking to be healed. They are asking to be released.'

name: Veins of the Wastes
description: The Ashen Wastes are rich with ore left behind by the old foundries. Gather enough Dreadsilver to reopen the Lantern Guard forge.
story: The ore remembers the heat of the old citadel. Someone forged weapons here before the Veil swallowed the road.

name: Hunters in the Ash
description: The Wastes have become hunting grounds for creatures touched by the Veil. Thin their packs before they reach the road.
story: The beasts are not simply wild. Their eyes follow the Lanterns as if something beneath the ash is teaching them to hunt.

name: The Executioner's Mark
description: Ashbound Executioners have begun appearing along the old imperial road. Find out who is sending them.
story: Every executioner carries the same black seal. The seal belongs to a court that was supposed to have died with the old kingdom.

name: The Veilscarred Mind
description: A group of Veilscarred Arcanists is gathering around a broken waystone. Stop them before they complete their ritual.
story: Their spellwork matches the marks found beneath the Gloamwood roots. The corruption is spreading along the old roads.

name: Alpha of the Wastes
description: The Dreadfang Alpha rules the southern ash fields. Bring down the beast and recover whatever it has been feeding on.
story: The alpha's hide is scarred with the same silver-black veins seen on the Hollow Saint's remains. The creatures of Ashenfall are becoming connected.

name: Dreadsilver Tempering
description: Take Dreadsilver from the Wastes and forge a weapon worthy of the next road into the Citadel.
story: A properly tempered Dreadsilver edge can hold its shape against Veil-corrupted armor.

name: The Ash That Rises
description: Leave the Black Citadel and cross into the Ashen Wastes to follow the black-silver trail found beneath the Vault.
story: The trail does not lead outward from the Citadel. It leads back toward the old roads, as if whatever waits below has been opening doors one at a time.
lore: The Veil scars follow roads built before the surviving kingdoms remember their names.
why: Vey needs someone outside the Citadel walls to determine whether the corruption is spreading along the old imperial roads.

name: The Black Seal
description: Defeat 3 Ashbound Executioners and recover the seal they carry.
story: Every executioner carries the same seal: a court-mark from an empire that should have died centuries ago. The seal is warm when held near Veil scars.
lore: The old kingdom did not vanish cleanly. Something preserved its authority beneath the ash.

name: Roads Without Names
description: Speak with Warden Kael about the old-road pattern and learn where the corruption is moving next.
story: Kael compares the seal with his records. The roads form a pattern around Eir-Vhal, but the missing road is the one leading north from the Citadel.
why: Kael can read the scars, but only someone who has walked the roads can tell whether the pattern is a map or a warning.

name: The Wastes Below
description: Defeat the Dreadfang Alpha and recover the silver-black fragment embedded in its hide.
story: The Alpha has been feeding on something beneath the ash. The fragment in its hide bears the same pattern as the seal and the wounds beneath Gloamwood.
lore: The corruption is no longer confined to ruins. It is teaching living creatures to carry the old seal.
why: If the same mark appears in beasts, soldiers and ancient guardians, the threat is becoming a system rather than an outbreak.

name: The Wall That Walks
chapter: Class Story  -  The Wall That Walks
description: Speak with vanguard_trainer and begin your class training.
story: A Vanguard learns that threat is a promise: the enemy will face them before it reaches the people behind them.

name: Hold the Gate
chapter: Class Story  -  The Wall That Walks
description: Defeat 3 hollow wolf and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: A Vanguard learns that threat is a promise: the enemy will face them before it reaches the people behind them.

name: The Last Wall
chapter: Class Story  -  The Wall That Walks
description: Defeat 1 grave brute and return to Sir Garrick.
story: The Weight of the Shield

name: Embers of Thought
description: Speak with arcanist_trainer and begin your class training.
story: An Arcanist learns to turn overwhelming power into deliberate pressure instead of spectacle.

name: A Controlled Flame
description: Defeat 3 gloomroot spider and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: An Arcanist learns to turn overwhelming power into deliberate pressure instead of spectacle.

name: The Burning Equation
description: Defeat 1 gloam cultist and return to Archmage Selene.
story: The Pattern in Fire

name: Roots That Remember
description: Speak with warden_trainer and begin your class training.
story: A Warden learns that support begins before the first wound: control the field and the party survives longer.

name: Listening to the Grove
description: Defeat 3 gloomroot spider and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: A Warden learns that support begins before the first wound: control the field and the party survives longer.

name: The Green Silence
description: Defeat 1 gloam huntmaster and return to Thornspeaker Lyra.
story: A Living Boundary

name: The Far Sight
description: Speak with ranger_trainer and begin your class training.
story: A Ranger learns that distance is responsibility: every shot changes where the enemy can safely move.

name: One Arrow, One Choice
description: Defeat 3 hollow wolf and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: A Ranger learns that distance is responsibility: every shot changes where the enemy can safely move.

name: The Hunter at Dusk
description: Defeat 1 gloam huntmaster and return to Ranger-Captain Rowan.
story: The Long Watch

name: Oath Beneath Ash
description: Speak with templar_trainer and begin your class training.
story: A Templar learns to carry both blade and protection without allowing either duty to consume the other.

name: The Measured Strike
description: Defeat 3 feral ravager and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: A Templar learns to carry both blade and protection without allowing either duty to consume the other.

name: The Oath Tested
description: Defeat 1 grave brute and return to High Templar Aldric.
story: A Shield of Faith

name: Names in the Dark
chapter: Class Story  -  Names in the Dark
description: Speak with occultist_trainer and begin your class training.
story: An Occultist learns that curses are not merely damage; they are ways of controlling what the enemy can become.

name: A Curse with Purpose
chapter: Class Story  -  Names in the Dark
description: Defeat 3 gloam cultist and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: An Occultist learns that curses are not merely damage; they are ways of controlling what the enemy can become.

name: The Name You Refuse
chapter: Class Story  -  Names in the Dark
description: Defeat 1 veilscarred arcanist and return to Occultist Morwen.
story: Ink and Ash

name: Blood Without Blindness
description: Speak with reaver_trainer and begin your class training.
story: A Reaver learns that rage is useful only when the warrior chooses where to spend it.

name: The Edge of Fury
description: Defeat 3 feral ravager and demonstrate your class discipline.
story: A Reaver learns that rage is useful only when the warrior chooses where to spend it.

name: The Red Road
description: Defeat 1 ashen reaver and return to Reaver Korr.
story: Fury with a Handle

name: The Eastern Road
description: Travel to Eastwatch and find Sergeant Mara before the old road patrol disappears.
story: Eastwatch is receiving orders sealed with a royal mark that no living commander recognizes.

name: Watchers on the Hill
description: Thin the Roadbandits threatening caravans near Eastwatch.

name: The Colossus of Eastwatch
description: Defeat the ancient guardian overlooking the eastern road.

name: The Old Kingdom Road
description: Travel to the Old Kingdom and find Archivist Elian.
story: The road into the Old Kingdom is intact despite having no living kingdom left to maintain it.

name: Echoes of the Crown
description: Defeat Hollow Knights and recover fragments of the old royal seal.

name: The Kingless Revenant
description: Put the last guardian of the old throne to rest.

name: Under Fire on the Eastern Road
description: Join the Caravan Under Fire event and help drive the attackers from the road.

name: Cleanse the Corrupted Expedition
description: Help purge the Corrupted Expedition before the Veil spreads deeper into Gloamwood.

name: Hold the Old Kingdom
description: Take part in the Undead Invasion and help the survivors hold the ruins.

name: Collapse the Veil Anomaly
description: Join the Veil Anomaly response and collapse the manifestation in the Ashen Wastes.

name: Watchers on the Hill
description: Defeat 5 risen guardians watching the road above Eastwatch.
story: The guardians do not attack the road caravans. They stand facing east, waiting for an order.

name: The Eastwatch Signal
description: Speak with Sergeant Mara after the signal tower answers a message from the ruins.
story: Mara heard the tower answer itself. The signal was addressed to a king who has been dead for generations.

name: The Broken Ledger
description: Speak with Archivist Elian and recover the surviving royal ledger.
story: Elian found the same black seal in royal tax ledgers, military orders and funeral records. The pattern predates the current kingdoms.

name: The Royal Descent
description: Enter the Royal Catacombs and reach the sealed royal vault.
story: The Royal Catacombs were not built to bury kings. They were built to keep something from remembering them.

name: The King Beneath
description: Defeat the King Beneath and recover the first stitching record.
story: The King Beneath speaks of the first stitch as an oath made by living people, not a spell cast by gods.

name: Roads That Remember
description: Return to the Ashen Wastes and follow the black seal along the old roads.
story: Kael says the seal is no longer merely spreading. It is choosing routes, as if something is planning a journey.

name: Memory in the Ash
description: Defeat 6 Ashen Reavers carrying fragments of the black seal.
story: Each Reaver repeats a different soldier name before it dies. None of the names belong to the same century.

name: Collapse the Anomaly
description: Join the Veil Anomaly response and collapse the manifestation in the Wastes.
story: The anomaly collapses, but the sound beneath it is a bell answering from somewhere much deeper.

name: The Watcher Hollow
description: Enter Watcher Hollow and find the surviving guardian records.
story: The Hollow guardians do not behave like undead. They behave like soldiers waiting for a court to resume session.

name: The Hollow Warden
description: Defeat the Hollow Warden and recover its command seal.
story: The Warden recognizes your name and asks which side of the first stitching you serve.

name: The Court That Waits
description: Speak with Kael and compare the Warden seal with the first stitching fragment.
story: Kael finally admits the truth: the old court was not destroyed. Its members were woven into the Veil as living memories.

name: Reckoning at the Citadel
description: Return to the Black Citadel and confront Quartermaster Vey about the original order.
story: Vey reveals that his first squad vanished because they found the same order beneath the Citadel and tried to obey it.

name: The Dead Guardian
description: Defeat 8 Dreadbound Guards and recover the old command tablets.
story: The tablets contain orders written in the handwriting of soldiers who died centuries apart.

name: The Door That Listens
description: Enter the Dreadvault and reach the door that remembers names.
story: The door does not open. It listens. Every name spoken near it becomes part of the seal.

name: The Name of the First
description: Defeat the Vault Tyrant and recover the oldest surviving name.
story: The Tyrant speaks the name of the first person who entered the Veil willingly, then asks whether you are ready to replace them.

name: The First Stitch
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Travel to the Old Kingdom and bring the first stitching fragments to Archivist Elian.
story: Elian realizes the fragments form a map, not a spell. The map points beneath the oldest royal tomb.

name: The Royal Memory
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Defeat 6 Royal Tomb Sentinels guarding the buried bell road.
story: The sentinels are protecting the road from the living. Their last command was not to keep the bell closed, but to keep anyone from answering it.

name: The Bells Beneath the World
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Collapse the final Veil Anomaly and silence the bell road.
story: When the anomaly collapses, every lantern in the region goes dark at once. Then one sixth lantern burns beneath the earth.

name: The Last Lantern
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Return to Captain Aric in Stonehold and decide what truth should be carried forward.
story: Aric does not ask whether you can save the world. He asks which names you refuse to let the world forget.

name: The Sixth Bell
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Speak with Archivist Elian and identify the sixth bell before the final anomaly is collapsed.
story: Elian confirms the sixth bell is not a weapon. It is the memory of the first stitch given a voice. Someone must choose whether that voice is remembered.

name: The World After
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Speak with Captain Aric and hear how Stonehold changed after the bells.
story: Speak with Captain Aric and hear how Stonehold changed after the bells.

name: The First Day After
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Travel to Stonehold’s outer wall and inspect the repaired lantern line.
story: Travel to Stonehold’s outer wall and inspect the repaired lantern line.

name: Names on the Wall
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Speak with Keeper Havel and preserve the names of those lost to the Veil.
story: Speak with Keeper Havel and preserve the names of those lost to the Veil.

name: The Road Ahead
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Travel to the Eastern Reach and confirm that the memory roads have gone quiet.
story: Travel to the Eastern Reach and confirm that the memory roads have gone quiet.

name: A Future, Not a Memory
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Speak with Archivist Elian and decide what knowledge should be taught openly.
story: Speak with Archivist Elian and decide what knowledge should be taught openly.

name: The Lantern You Carry
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Return to Stonehold and light a new lantern for the next generation.
story: Return to Stonehold and light a new lantern for the next generation.

name: Ashenfall
chapter: Chapter X  -  The Bells Beneath the World
description: Stand before Captain Aric and choose what kind of guardian you will become after the first campaign.
story: Stand before Captain Aric and choose what kind of guardian you will become after the first campaign.

story: Help the Lantern Guard rebuild the memorial roster.

story: Carry a message for the Covenant without surrendering your judgment.

name: Hold the Hollow Road
description: Defeat creatures threatening the road beyond the Citadel.
story: Hold the road long enough for the Bastion to resupply.

name: Sealbreak Patrol
description: Destroy the guardians around the broken seal.
story: The old seal is failing and its guardians are waking.

name: The Breachwarden
description: Defeat the Citadel Breachwarden.
story: Bring down the elite that has made the road its kingdom.

name: The Bells in the Fen
description: Travel into Briarfen and find Fenwatch before the drowned lantern road disappears.
story: Vey expected the trail to point into the Wastes. Instead, the black seal turns east into a drowned frontier where old Lantern Guard posts are still burning. Someone has been ringing them from beneath the water.

name: Fenwatch at Dusk
description: Speak with Watcher Elira at Fenwatch and learn why the marsh patrols are abandoning the old causeway.
story: Elira has not lost soldiers to the marsh. She has lost them to orders written in a hand no living officer recognizes. The orders always end with the same instruction: ring the sixth bell.

name: Thorns That Remember
description: Defeat 6 Thorn Hags around the drowned causeways and recover the black-veined thorns growing from their bodies.
story: The thorns are not ordinary growth. Each one carries a tiny groove like writing. Kael later identifies the marks as road directions.

name: The Drowned Road
description: Defeat 8 Marshbone Hounds guarding the submerged road to Thornmere.
story: The hounds are guarding a road that should have ended centuries ago. Beneath the mud, its stones still point toward Eir-Vhal.

name: Reclaim the Lantern Causeway
description: Join the Fen Reclamation and restore the drowned lantern posts.
story: When the causeway is reclaimed, the lanterns all ignite in sequence. The final light points toward the Ashen Wastes.

name: The Red Road
description: Travel to Sunscar Steppe and find Caravanmaster Joren before the next convoy leaves the red grasslands.
story: The black seal has reached the caravan roads. Joren says raiders are attacking supply wagons, but they are stealing ledgers instead of food.

name: Caravan of Names
description: Defeat 7 Sunscar Raiders and recover the sealed orders they carry.
story: Every order names a different dead commander. The raiders are not looting the caravans; they are searching for the names written on their manifests.

name: Redmaw Omens
description: Defeat 6 Redmaw Hyenas near the battlefield markers and recover the bone tokens in their jaws.
story: The tokens are carved with old road numbers. The same numbers appear on the Eastwatch signal tower.

name: The Caravan Signal
description: Speak with Caravanmaster Joren after the convoy survives the Sunscar road.
story: Joren admits the caravan has been carrying messages for Eastwatch without knowing it. The old road network is using living travelers as couriers.

name: War on the Red Grass
description: Join the Sunscar Caravan War and keep the eastern road open.
story: The surviving caravan reaches Eastwatch. Its final cargo is not gold or weapons, but a royal dispatch addressed to a king who has been dead for centuries.

name: The Crownfall Road
description: Travel to Crownfall Expanse and find Royal Archivist Neris at the Last Bastion.
story: The royal dispatch leads west instead of north. Crownfall is the missing link between the Eastern Reach and the buried court.

name: Bones of the Crown
description: Defeat 8 Royal Boneguards guarding the ruined royal estates.
story: The Boneguards still salute passing travelers. Their orders are centuries old, but their patrol routes match the living road network exactly.

name: The Crownless Witch
description: Defeat 5 Crownless Witches and recover the royal memory seals they protect.
story: The witches call the seals "inheritance". They claim the old kingdom did not die; it merely moved beneath the world.

name: The Crown Rises
description: Join the Crownfall Rebellion and stop the royal dead from reaching the living camps.
story: When the uprising breaks, Neris finds a ledger page naming the royal catacombs as the first place where the old court hid its memory.

name: The Missing Royal Page
description: Speak with Neris and recover the page that points toward the Old Kingdom.
story: The missing page confirms that the first Veil stitching was recorded beneath the royal court. Elian must see it.

name: The Highland Ascent
description: Travel to the Veilscar Highlands and find Stormwarden Ilyra at Highland Watch.
story: The stitching record contains a route that climbs above the old roads. The Veil is not only remembering the roads below; it is using the highlands as a pressure valve.

name: Wraiths in the Storm
description: Defeat 8 Aether Wraiths inside the storm belt.
story: The wraiths repeat fragments of old travel prayers. Each fragment points to a different road, proving the memory network is active.

name: Orders in the Thunder
description: Defeat 5 Stormbound Arcanists and recover the orders they are transmitting through the storm.
story: The arcanists are broadcasting the same command heard at Eastwatch: prepare the roads for the return of the court.

name: Break the Storm Anchor
description: Join the Highland Storm and destroy its memory anchor.
story: The storm collapses. Beneath it is a road carved directly into the mountain, descending toward the coast.

name: The Black Tide
description: Travel to Nightveil Coast and find Tidewarden Sera before the black tide reaches the inland road.
story: Kael expected the memory roads to end at the Hollow. Instead they continue beneath the sea. Something has been carrying the court eastward through drowned ruins.

name: Drowned Warband
description: Defeat 9 Nightveil Reavers along the drowned shore.
story: The drowned soldiers carry weapons stamped with the same royal mark found in Crownfall. Their armor is wet, but their orders are dry and recent.

name: Voices Under the Tide
description: Defeat 6 Hollowtide Witches and recover the shells they use to speak with the Hollow.
story: The shells whisper names from the Hollow Court. One voice calls the player by name without ever having met them.

name: Hold the Black Tide
description: Join the Nightveil Black Tide defense and keep the final road open.
story: When the tide recedes, it exposes a road of black stone leading toward the Hollow. The road is dry. It has never seen the sea.

name: The Behemoth at Low Tide
description: Defeat the Nightveil Behemoth guarding the exposed road.
story: The Behemoth falls and the road opens. Far inland, a bell answers once.

name: Lanterns in Black Water
description: Recover 5 lost lanterns from Fen Stalkers along the drowned road.
story: Pell says the lanterns were dropped by people who were walking toward the water, not away from it.

name: Bones in the Reeds
description: Defeat 6 Marshbone Hounds and recover the old patrol tags from their collars.
story: The tags belonged to three different patrols that vanished decades apart.

name: The Last Ferry
description: Speak with Elira after securing the old ferry crossing.
story: Elira remembers the ferry bell ringing by itself every new moon.

name: Relics Under Thorn
description: Defeat 5 Thorn Hags guarding relic fragments beneath the marsh.
story: The relics are pieces of old road markers, each carved with the same unknown route.

name: Fenwatch Holds
description: Join the Fen Reclamation and keep Fenwatch supplied.
story: The camp survives because strangers keep choosing to return.

name: Blood on the Caravan Road
description: Defeat 6 Sunscar Raiders stalking the southern convoy route.
story: Nima is less worried about stolen goods than about the raiders asking for passenger names.

name: Ashwing Season
description: Defeat 7 Ashwing Vultures circling the abandoned battlefield.
story: The vultures refuse fresh corpses and instead pick at old armor bearing royal marks.

name: Waystones of the Red Road
description: Speak with Pathfinder Nima after tracing the old road waystones.
story: The waystones form a route that does not appear on any living map.

name: The Red Ridge Relic
description: Defeat 5 Redmaw Hyenas near Red Ridge and recover the buried relic.
story: The relic is a signal key for an Eastwatch tower that has been silent for generations.

name: Caravan Scars
description: Join the Sunscar Caravan War and escort the surviving wagons.
story: The caravan masters begin writing the names of every traveler they lose. The old court hates being remembered.

name: The Bone Tithe
description: Defeat 7 Royal Boneguards collecting tribute from ruined estates.
story: The dead still collect taxes because nobody ever told them the kingdom ended.

name: Reclaim the Estate
description: Defeat 6 Ashbound Reclaimers inside the abandoned estates.
story: The Reclaimers rebuild walls around houses that no longer have owners.

name: Witchglass
description: Defeat 4 Crownless Witches and recover their black glass mirrors.
story: Each mirror shows Crownfall as it looked before the ash.

name: The Last Royal Patrol
description: Speak with Gravewarden Tomas after the royal patrol is broken.
story: Tomas has spent years maintaining graves for soldiers whose families stopped remembering them.

name: Names Beneath the Crown
description: Join the Crownfall Rebellion and recover the names carved into the royal standards.
story: For the first time, the dead stop marching when someone speaks their names aloud.

name: The Oreline
description: Defeat 6 Veilscar Raiders guarding the exposed mountain oreline.
story: Rusk says the mountain is shedding metal whenever the storm flashes.

name: Signal Through Stone
description: Speak with Climber Rusk after reaching the Stormscar signal point.
story: The signal point answers a voice from beneath the mountain.

name: The Gargoyle Roost
description: Defeat 5 Highland Gargoyles around the ruined watchtower.
story: The gargoyles are arranged like sentries facing the same road.

name: Aether Shards
description: Defeat 6 Aether Wraiths and collect the fragments they leave behind.
story: The fragments hum in different voices. None are speaking the same language.

name: The Long Climb
description: Join the Highland Storm and keep the mountain path open.
story: The storm is quieter after the adventurers leave, as if it learned their footsteps.

name: The Drowned Who Walk
description: Defeat 8 Nightveil Drowned along the old tide road.
story: Venn says the drowned are walking toward the inland road, not toward the sea.

name: Drowned Anchors
description: Defeat 6 Nightveil Reavers guarding the ancient tide anchors.
story: The anchors were built for ships that could sail through stone.

name: Names in Tideglass
description: Speak with Dredger Venn after recovering the tideglass name plates.
story: The plates list the same dead commanders found in Sunscar.

name: Tracks of the Behemoth
description: Defeat 4 Hollowtide Witches and follow the tracks they were protecting.
story: The tracks stop at a dry road beneath the sea.

name: Coast of Whispers
description: Join the Nightveil Black Tide defense and protect the tidewatch camp.
story: The black tide recedes long enough for everyone to hear a bell beneath the surf.

name: After the Caravan
description: Visit the Eastwatch quartermaster and learn what survived the attack.
story: The outcome of the caravan under fire has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: The Forest Breathes
description: Speak with the Lantern Rest warden about the expedition you helped reclaim.
story: The outcome of the corrupted expedition has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: Quiet the Graves
description: Check the old kingdom watch after the dead have been pushed back.
story: The outcome of the undead invasion has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: A Safer Road
description: Speak with the frontier captain and confirm the village road is open again.
story: The outcome of the village defense has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: The Seal Holds
description: Report to the frontier wardens after the Hollow breach is contained.
story: The outcome of the hollow breach has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: Ash After the Storm
description: Inspect the anomaly site after the Veil disturbance collapses.
story: The outcome of the veil anomaly has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: Lanterns Reclaimed
description: Speak with the Fen Reclamation crew about the restored causeways.
story: The outcome of the fen reclamation has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: The Road Is Open
description: Check in with the Sunscar caravan master after the raid.
story: The outcome of the sunscar caravan has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: The Crown Lies Quiet
description: Report to the surviving Crownfall camp after the rebellion ends.
story: The outcome of the crownfall rebellion has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: Clear Skies
description: Speak with the highland stormcaller after the anchor collapses.
story: The outcome of the highland storm has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: When the Tide Recedes
description: Inspect the coast camp after the black tide withdraws.
story: The outcome of the nightveil tide has changed the region. You are asked to witness what comes next.

name: The Seventh Lantern Watch
description: Defeat 5 Gloam Huntmasters before the dusk watch loses another patrol route.
story: Kael marks the seventh lantern route in red ink. The hunters have learned to stalk the patrols between the lights.

name: Ashes Beneath the Ledger
description: Defeat 6 Ashbound Reclaimers and recover the seals they stole from the old kingdom archives.
story: Archivist Elian refuses to let the Crownfall dead erase the names of those who guarded the kingdom before it fell.
